spec_match.rationale: Reworked in place (justified factual-error fix): the page now demonstrates the actual v145 feature — TC39 Map.prototype.getOrInsert/getOrInsertComputed (plus WeakMap probe) — exactly the surfaces the feature's immutable conformance suite asserts; the IndexedDB put() material is gone.

interactive.rationale: Live Map playground (getOrInsert, check-then-set comparison, getOrInsertComputed with callback counter), an interleaved-writer race simulation, and a callback re-entrancy test all drove correctly via CDP; map/log readouts update per action.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Feature index lede, background, code sample, card blurb, and references were repointed from IndexedDB to the ECMAScript proposal in the same fix.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers insert-on-miss, return-existing-on-hit, callback-only-on-miss, lost-update race vs atomic upsert, and the spec's callback-re-entrancy rule (return value overwrites mid-callback set); WeakMap surface probed.

references.rationale: chromestatus.com/feature/5201653661827072 (self-heal), tc39/proposal-upsert, and MDN Map are linked; the misleading IDBObjectStore.put reference was removed.

conformance.rationale: The immutable feature-level suite was not touched; the demo now exercises the same contracts it asserts, and the suite still honestly fails 0/7 on this pre-145 browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: ?autorun=1 driven end-to-end in headless Chromium 141 via CDP: probes read undefined (honest), polyfill path labelled, race demo showed lost update vs consistent result, re-entrancy returned 'returned-from-callback'; console clean except environmental fonts request; desktop+mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert fires with distinct ids for native vs polyfill branches (upsert-getorinsert-native/-polyfill, upsert-race-demo, upsert-reentrancy-*), so a fallback is never reported as the native pass.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout; warn state uses AA-safe charcoal bold instead of low-contrast amber text.

accessibility.rationale: Inputs have visible labels, log is role=log aria-live=polite, all controls are native buttons with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 DPR3 after adding overflow-wrap for long API names in prose; desktop 1280 clean; both screenshots read.

They are published routes, so per the durable-demo contract they need in-place factual-error fixes (like this one) or honestly reframed copy — not deletion. Their card descriptions on the index still describe what those pages currently do.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Allow long unbreakable inline strings to wrap (overflow-wrap) instead of forcing horizontal page overflow.

summary: In-place rework of the worst v145 defect: the page demonstrated IndexedDB put() while the feature is TC39 Map.getOrInsert/getOrInsertComputed. Same route/slug/title; now an interactive playground for the real API with honest native probes, a clearly labelled spec-modelling polyfill fallback, race and re-entrancy edge cases, and updated index blurb/references. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
